name: Arlecchino
quote: We don't want to make the children cry...
description: Also known as "The Knave," Arlecchino is the fourth of the Fatui Harbingers and head of the House of the Hearth, an orphanage and intelligence agency in Fontaine where the children call her "Father." Ruthless in her duties yet devoted to those in her care, she is regarded as one of Teyvat's most formidable and morally complex figures.
